Principle 8 : Sunday
(Christian)
There are many religions in Korea.
My family is Christian so every Sunday we go to church.
We see lots of friends when we go.
I am very happy to go to church we sing hymns, listen to the sermon and study the bible.
Sunday is always a great day at the church.
Because we have religion in our lives we are very happy.
(Buddhist)
Many Korean people believe in Buddha but they don’t always go to temple every week.
Usually people only go to temple two or three times a year for special events.
When people go to temple their heart is very peaceful and are free from worry about stress in their lives.
Whenever my family goes hiking we visit the temple.
Because we have religion in our lives we are very happy.
(Atheist)
There are atheists in Korea.
My family spends their time differently on Sunday.
My husband sometimes goes fishing or hiking or meets his friends, sometimes he watches TV.
My children usually meet their friends or stay home and play computer games.
I usually go shopping or meet my friends.
Although we spend our day differently we are together for dinner and usually visit relatives or attend wedding ceremonies.
Sundays are a good time to receive strength in order to start a new week.
